title: dpl.episode/2 — one episode: its lessons, in order, by id
description: An episode built from lessons, at <content>/<show>/<episode>/episode.json (LS3b, R285). The lessons float: a lesson's change shows in every episode using it (ruled 2026-10-24, "Show lessons as they are"); the lessons pin their cards. The episode's theme is theme.json beside it. A template (a seed, or a content episode LS3b2 has not moved) is the older chapters-of-slide-folders shape, read by its own loader. docs/plans/lessons-ls3.md §4.5b.

id.description: A permanent ULID — the folder name is the episode's address.

lessons.description: Its lessons, in teaching order, by id.
